idea: Basic plumbing maintenance every homeowner should know
title: Simple Checks to Protect Your Home's Plumbing
description: Taking care of your home's plumbing does not require complex tools. Start by locating your main water shut-off valve so you can act quickly in an emergency. Test the valve once a year to ensure it turns smoothly. Next, clean sink strainers and shower drains weekly to prevent slow buildup. Avoid pouring fats or grease down the kitchen sink, as they solidify inside pipes over time. Lastly, inspect visible pipes under sinks for small drips or corrosion monthly. Catching minor leaks early saves water and prevents structural damage. If you notice persistent leaks, low water pressure, or strange pipe noises, contact a licensed plumber for a thorough inspection.
